name: List All Community Association Bank Account Balances
description: Returns Community Association (CA) bank account balances that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[AssociationId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the Community Association. All GET requests must include this filter.

responseFields.name: data[].BankAccountId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the CA bank account

responseFields.name: data[].AssociationId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the Community Association attached to the bank account

responseFields.name: data[].BankAccountName
responseFields.description: The name of the CA's bank account

responseFields.name: data[].BankAccountNumber
responseFields.description: Unique reference number of the CA bank account

responseFields.name: data[].BankAccountType
responseFields.description: The type of bank account used for the Community Association

responseFields.name: data[].Balance
responseFields.description: The CA bank account's most recent statement balance

responseFields.name: data[].BalanceAsOf
responseFields.description: The date of the CA bank account's most recent statement balance

responseFields.name: data[].GlAccountIds
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the general ledger account(s) associated with the CA bank account

responseFields.name: data[].Reserve
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the CA bank account is a reserve bank account

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
